FN-98D5BMP-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 34
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative Jim Hill
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/27/2024
House Bill 34 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Supreme Court and the Court
of Criminal Appeals, by an estimated $56,000 and $35,000 annually, respectively, paid from the
State General Fund for judicial compensation beginning in Fiscal Year 2025 and each fiscal year
thereafter, according to the Administrative Office of the Courts, by permitting the use of bench
experience for certain district or circuit court judges that are elected or appointed to an appellate
court or the supreme court.
